meta.title: Top 100 Gyms in the World 2026
meta.subtitle: The most influential training grounds on earth — ranked. Iron meccas, champion factories, luxury clubs, and the outdoor pits people cross oceans to train in.

scoreModel.name: Gym Influence Score
scoreModel.gate: Specific, visitable gyms only. Chains enter through individual locations judged as places — never as a brand in the abstract. Independent gyms and chain flagships are scored on the same scale.
scoreModel.notes: Reach is log-scaled and recomputed from each gym's researched follower counts. The five judgment factors — legacy, talent, facility, community, destination — are calibrated across research segments so no category is scored on an easier curve. Counts marked verified were browser-checked at the listed date; the rest are approximate.

meta.disclaimer: Details are editorial estimates (2026) and the ranking is reviewed monthly. Inclusion is not an endorsement; gyms open, move, and close — check before you travel.

entries.name: CrossFit Mayhem
entries.who: Rich Froning's home box and training compound, anchor of the Mayhem Nation programming and apparel brand.
entries.why: Base for a four-time individual and multiple-time team CrossFit Games champion; drives one of the sport's largest media operations.
entries.takeaway: Seek out the Mayhem Nation programming boards and train alongside the culture that built a four-time champion.

entries.name: Westside Barbell
entries.who: Private, invite-only powerlifting gym founded by Louie Simmons, birthplace of the Conjugate Method.
entries.why: Produced more elite raw and equipped powerlifting world records than any gym in history; the sport's acknowledged mecca.
entries.takeaway: You cannot drop in — but you can run its conjugate method: rotate max-effort and dynamic days.

entries.name: Gold's Gym Venice
entries.who: The original Gold's Gym, founded on Venice Beach in 1965 and now on Hampton Drive.
entries.why: Known worldwide as "the Mecca of bodybuilding" — Arnold Schwarzenegger and generations of champions trained here, and it still draws lifters on pilgrimage.
entries.reach: IG 31K on the location account @goldsgymvenice1; global Gold's Gym brand account is 455K (verified 2026-08)
entries.takeaway: Go early, train among the pilgrims, and study how the old guard structures a session.

entries.name: Muscle Beach Venice
entries.who: City-run open-air weight pit and gymnastics platform on the Venice Beach boardwalk, running since 1963.
entries.why: The original stage where 1970s-80s bodybuilding performed for the public; still free, outdoors, and open to any visitor.
entries.reach: No single official IG account; heavy UGC under #MuscleBeachVenice (approx 2026)
entries.takeaway: Free and open to all — claim a spot on the platform where 1970s-80s bodybuilding first performed for the public.

entries.name: American Top Team
entries.who: Large MMA super-team headquarters with dozens of pro fighters training under one roof.
entries.why: Produced numerous UFC and Bellator champions since 2001; a repeat MMA Gym of the Year winner.
entries.takeaway: Watch dozens of pro fighters share one roof and see why titles keep coming from this single training floor.

entries.name: MetroFlex Gym (Original)
entries.who: The original MetroFlex warehouse gym, running since 1987, marketed as "the gym that built Ronnie Coleman."
entries.why: Home turf of 8x Mr. Olympia Ronnie Coleman and 2x Arnold Classic champion Branch Warren; raw, no-frills training culture that spawned a national gym chain.
entries.reach: Instagram @originalmetroflexgym; open and active, follower count not confirmed (verified 2026-08)
entries.takeaway: Skip the polish — this raw, no-frills warehouse floor is the culture that built Ronnie Coleman.

entries.name: CompTrain (formerly CrossFit New England)
entries.who: Ben Bergeron's strength-and-conditioning gym, rebuilt from the de-affiliated CrossFit New England.
entries.why: Produced Mat Fraser and Katrin Davidsdottir; its whiteboard-and-mindset culture became a template copied across the sport.
entries.warning: De-affiliated from CrossFit HQ and rebranded CompTrain; no longer an official CrossFit affiliate but still the same physical gym and program lineage.
entries.takeaway: Study the whiteboard-and-mindset culture that shaped Mat Fraser and Katrin Davidsdottir into champions.

entries.name: EliteFTS Compound
entries.who: Dave Tate's training compound and equipment-company headquarters, the other pole of American powerlifting alongside Westside.
entries.why: Decades of educational content, sponsored lifters, and the elitefts media machine make it a reference point for the whole strength-training industry.
entries.takeaway: Treat it as a classroom — decades of Dave Tate's educational strength content live on this training floor.

entries.name: Tiger Muay Thai & MMA Training Camp
entries.who: Large international training camp offering Muay Thai, MMA, and BJJ to thousands of visiting fighters yearly.
entries.why: A global bucket-list combat-sports destination, with a training population and social reach far beyond any single team.
entries.takeaway: Join thousands of visiting fighters training Muay Thai, MMA and BJJ side by side at this bucket-list camp.

entries.name: Binous Gym
entries.who: Bodybuilding gym founded by Tunisian trainer Anis Binous, built around rare specialist equipment and a serious-athlete training floor.
entries.why: Draws top international bodybuilders, celebrities, and influencers visiting the Gulf; runs its own Binous Classic muscle show.
entries.reach: IG 91K (@binousgym_ gym account; affiliated @binousclassic event brand has 589K, verified 2026-08)
entries.warning: A larger second location was under construction in Jumeirah Village Circle at last check; the original Al Quoz gym is the current flagship.
entries.takeaway: Seek out the rare specialist equipment that draws elite bodybuilders, and ask about the Binous Classic show.

entries.name: Dogpound
entries.who: Invite-only strength and conditioning studio founded by trainer Kirk Myers, with a sister location in Los Angeles.
entries.why: The most photographed personal-training gym in the world; actors and models train there, gated by a roughly 100-person waitlist.
entries.takeaway: It's invite-only with a roughly 100-person waitlist — this is where actors and models actually train, not pose.

entries.name: American Kickboxing Academy (AKA)
entries.who: Wrestling-and-striking MMA gym in San Jose, co-founded by Javier Mendez.
entries.why: Produced multiple UFC champions (Cain Velasquez, Daniel Cormier) and hosted Khabib Nurmagomedov's fight camps.
entries.takeaway: Watch the wrestling-and-striking blend that produced multiple UFC champions and hosted Khabib's fight camps.

entries.name: CrossFit Invictus
entries.who: Longstanding San Diego box and one of the sport's most influential coaching-education and programming brands.
entries.why: Its methodology and seminars shaped how competitive CrossFit is coached worldwide since the mid-2000s.
entries.takeaway: Sit in on the coaching methodology and seminars that shaped how competitive CrossFit is coached worldwide.

entries.name: Jackson Wink MMA Academy
entries.who: MMA academy co-founded by coaches Greg Jackson and Mike Winkeljohn.
entries.why: Trained Jon Jones and Holly Holm among many champions; a pilgrimage stop for serious strikers and grapplers.
entries.takeaway: A pilgrimage stop for strikers and grapplers — study the system that trained Jon Jones and Holly Holm.

entries.name: Kachalka Muscle Beach
entries.who: Sprawling free outdoor gym on Dolobetskyi Island with 200-plus homemade machines welded from scrap metal since the 1970s.
entries.why: One of the biggest DIY outdoor gyms on earth, spanning roughly 10,000 square meters; famous for training champions, celebrities, and factory workers side by side.
entries.reach: No official IG account; documented mainly through international photo essays (approx 2026)
entries.warning: Historically reopens fast after disruptions, but day-to-day status during the ongoing war was not independently reconfirmed for 2026.
entries.takeaway: Try the homemade scrap-metal machines and train shoulder to shoulder with champions, celebrities, and factory workers alike.

entries.name: Zoo Culture
entries.who: Members-only gym and social club built by bodybuilder-YouTuber Bradley Martyn, a fixture for LA fitness creators and celebrities.
entries.why: One of the first gyms built entirely from a creator's personal brand — turned Bradley Martyn's online fame into a real-world hangout-and-train destination.
entries.takeaway: A members-only social club built on Bradley Martyn's brand — go see how online fame becomes a real training culture.

entries.name: Art of Jiu-Jitsu (AOJ)
entries.who: Competition-focused BJJ academy founded by Rafael and Guilherme Mendes.
entries.why: Produces a steady stream of IBJJF and ADCC world champions and draws competitive grapplers worldwide.
entries.takeaway: Watch competition-focused BJJ drilling from the Mendes brothers' system that keeps producing IBJJF and ADCC champions.

entries.name: PRVN Fitness
entries.who: Garage-style training facility built by coach Shane Orr for his wife Tia-Clair Toomey-Orr's programming brand.
entries.why: Home base of the most decorated woman in CrossFit Games history, now a widely followed methodology and gear brand.
entries.takeaway: Study the garage-style programming built around the most decorated woman in CrossFit Games history.

entries.name: Equinox Hudson Yards
entries.who: Equinox's largest club, anchoring the Hudson Yards tower with a dedicated E by Equinox training floor and rooftop pool.
entries.why: The most recognized luxury gym brand in the US; Hudson Yards is its architectural showcase and a status symbol for Manhattan members.
entries.takeaway: Go for the E by Equinox training floor and rooftop pool — the brand's architectural showcase.

entries.name: Barry's West Hollywood
entries.who: Barry's rebuilt flagship on Santa Monica Boulevard, replacing the original 1998 La Cienega studio with a larger Red Room.
entries.why: The birthplace of the 'world's best workout' brand and celebrity-favorite HIIT franchise; still its cultural home base.
entries.takeaway: Take a Red Room class at the birthplace of the 'world's best workout,' still the brand's cultural home base.

entries.name: Wild Card Boxing Club
entries.who: Small, famously no-frills second-floor boxing gym in Hollywood run by trainer Freddie Roach.
entries.why: Trained Manny Pacquiao to multiple world titles; open 365 days a year and a bucket-list stop for boxing fans.
entries.takeaway: No-frills and open 365 days a year — watch the system that trained Manny Pacquiao to world titles.

entries.name: Renzo Gracie Academy
entries.who: Historic Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu and MMA academy in Manhattan founded by Renzo Gracie.
entries.why: One of the founding academies of the US BJJ and MMA boom; produced champions in both grappling and the cage.
entries.takeaway: Train at one of the founding academies of the US BJJ and MMA boom, still producing champions in both.

entries.name: IMG Academy
entries.who: Multi-sport boarding-school and training campus in Bradenton, Florida, covering a dozen sports.
entries.why: World-unique in scale and facilities; alumni include top tennis, golf, and football pros across five decades.
entries.reach: IG following split across sport-specific accounts (approx 2026, not independently confirmed)
entries.takeaway: Tour the world-unique multi-sport campus that has produced top tennis, golf, and football pros for five decades.

entries.name: Fairtex Training Center
entries.who: One of Thailand's oldest and most famous Muay Thai training camps.
entries.why: Produced generations of Lumpinee and Rajadamnern Stadium champions; a top pilgrimage stop for Muay Thai.
entries.takeaway: A top Muay Thai pilgrimage stop — train under the lineage that produced generations of stadium champions.

entries.name: Bev Francis' Powerhouse Gym
entries.who: An independent hardcore gym on Long Island founded by IFBB legend Bev Francis, billed as "the East Coast Mecca of bodybuilding."
entries.why: Trains top NPC and IFBB competitors — Chris Bumstead used it during a 2022 Olympia prep stretch — and keeps a coaching-floor culture built around Francis's own competitive record.
entries.reach: Facebook 59K; X (@eastcoastmecca) 17.4K; Instagram follower count not confirmed (verified open 2026-08)
entries.takeaway: Seek out the coaching-floor culture Bev Francis built from her own competitive record — Chris Bumstead once prepped here.

entries.name: CrossFit Reykjavik
entries.who: Iceland's flagship box, training ground for the country's cluster of world-class CrossFit athletes.
entries.why: Home of two-time Games champion Annie Thorisdottir and an international 'super team' of transplant athletes drawn to Iceland's training culture.
entries.takeaway: Meet the international 'super team' of transplant athletes drawn to Iceland's training culture around champion Annie Thorisdottir.

entries.name: Thor's Power Gym
entries.who: Strongman gym built by Hafthor Bjornsson ('The Mountain'), fitted with equipment custom-made by Rogue Fitness for his own training.
entries.why: A genuine pilgrimage stop for strongman tourists in Iceland, doubling as a small museum of Bjornsson's world-record lifts and trophies.
entries.takeaway: Study the custom Rogue equipment Bjornsson built for himself, and browse the trophy wall of his world records.

entries.name: Kings MMA
entries.who: Huntington Beach MMA gym led by striking coach Rafael Cordeiro.
entries.why: Carries the Chute Boxe striking lineage and has coached Fedor Emelianenko, Anderson Silva, and other elite strikers.
entries.takeaway: Train the Chute Boxe striking lineage that shaped Fedor Emelianenko and Anderson Silva under coach Rafael Cordeiro.

entries.name: Team Alpha Male
entries.who: Sacramento MMA team founded in 2004 by former UFC champion Urijah Faber.
entries.why: Produced three UFC champions (T.J. Dillashaw, Cody Garbrandt, Deiveson Figueiredo) out of one training room.
entries.takeaway: One training room produced three UFC champions — watch how Urijah Faber's team builds them.

entries.name: Gold's Gym Harajuku
entries.who: 24-hour, four-floor Gold's Gym club steps from Harajuku Station, open since 2002 with a hardcore basement floor known as Classic Gold.
entries.why: Japan's best-known Gold's Gym location, regularly drawing athletes and entertainers from the surrounding entertainment district.
entries.reach: Location IG account exists (@goldsgym.harajukutokyo); follower count not confirmed (approx 2026)
entries.takeaway: Head down to the hardcore Classic Gold basement floor, the part of this 24-hour club athletes actually seek out.

entries.name: P3 Applied Sports Science
entries.who: Sports-science and athletic-performance lab in Santa Barbara using force plates and 3D motion capture.
entries.why: Trusted by a majority of NBA teams and the default stop for pre-draft prospects preparing for the combine.
entries.takeaway: Expect force-plate and motion-capture testing over barbells — this is where NBA prospects prep for the draft combine.

entries.name: Gymshark Lifting Club
entries.who: Gymshark's own gym and innovation hub at its Solihull HQ, built to test product and shoot athlete content on-site.
entries.why: The physical anchor of the biggest fitness-apparel creator economy in the world — sponsored athletes train and film here.
entries.takeaway: Watch sponsored athletes film content on the same floor where Gymshark tests its own gear.

entries.name: Bondi Beach Outdoor Gym
entries.who: Council-built calisthenics park in Bondi Park with pull-up bars at multiple heights, dip bars, parallel bars, and monkey bars.
entries.why: Free, open 24/7 every day of the year, and famous for turning workouts into a beachfront show for passersby.
entries.reach: No single official IG; managed by Waverley Council (verified open 2026-08)
entries.takeaway: Free and open 24/7 — bring your calisthenics skills, because Bondi turns every set into a beachfront show.

entries.name: Dragon's Lair Gym
entries.who: A 12,600 sq ft hardcore training facility owned by 7x 212lb Mr. Olympia Flex Lewis, with 115+ machines and dedicated power racks.
entries.why: Gives fans a direct line to a reigning Olympia-class champion's personal training approach, with regular pro visits and seminars.
entries.reach: Instagram @the_dragons_lair; open, follower count not confirmed (verified 2026-08)
entries.takeaway: Check the seminar schedule — regular pro visits give you a direct line to Flex Lewis's own training approach.

entries.name: Temple Gym
entries.who: The gym built by 6x Mr. Olympia Dorian Yates, now relocated to Birmingham's Jewellery Quarter.
entries.why: Defined the 1990s "blood and guts" high-intensity training era; still draws UK and international lifters tracing Yates's method.
entries.reach: Instagram @templegymuk; relocated but active, listings current as of July 2026 (verified 2026-08)
entries.takeaway: Study the high-intensity 'blood and guts' method Dorian Yates built here — brief, brutal sets, not marathon sessions.

entries.name: Pahlevanpour Zurkhaneh
entries.who: One of Tehran's oldest active zurkhanehs ("houses of strength"), a domed hall for varzesh-e pahlavani, Iran's ritual strength-and-ethics sport.
entries.why: The clearest surviving link to a training culture that predates the modern gym by centuries, combining calisthenics, wooden clubs, and live drumming and poetry.
entries.reach: No IG presence; a traditional institution, not a social-media brand (approx 2026)
entries.takeaway: Watch varzesh-e pahlavani performed with wooden clubs, live drumming and poetry — training as ritual, not reps.

entries.name: Straight Blast Gym Ireland
entries.who: Dublin MMA academy led by coach John Kavanagh, hub of the SBG international affiliate network.
entries.why: Developed Conor McGregor from teenager to two-division UFC champion, making it a global MMA pilgrimage site.
entries.takeaway: Study the coaching patience that took Conor McGregor from teenager to two-division champion under John Kavanagh.

entries.name: Evolve MMA
entries.who: Asia's largest MMA academy network, headquartered in Singapore across multiple branded locations.
entries.why: Trained numerous ONE Championship world champions; the default combat-sports stop for visitors to Southeast Asia.
entries.takeaway: Default combat-sports stop in Southeast Asia — train alongside the system that produced ONE Championship world champions.

entries.name: Gleason's Gym
entries.who: The oldest active boxing gym in the United States, operating in Brooklyn since 1937.
entries.why: Trained generations of world champions from the Ali era to modern pros; a living museum of boxing history.
entries.takeaway: Walk through boxing history — this living museum has trained world champions from the Ali era to today's pros.

entries.name: EXOS
entries.who: Human-performance training campus in Phoenix, headquarters of the EXOS athletic performance company.
entries.why: Trains NFL Combine prospects and pro athletes across major leagues with sports-science-driven programs.
entries.takeaway: Expect sports-science-driven programming built for NFL Combine prospects, not a typical gym-floor workout.

entries.name: Training Think Tank
entries.who: Atlanta-area box built around a coaching staff of CrossFit Games veterans, led by nine-time Games athlete Travis Mayer.
entries.why: One of the deeper competitive coaching benches outside the traditional CrossFit power centers, with a fast-growing following.
entries.takeaway: Learn from a coaching staff stacked with CrossFit Games veterans led by nine-time competitor Travis Mayer.

entries.name: Alphaland
entries.who: 18.5-acre fitness compound built by YouTuber and Alphalete founder Christian Guzman — three gyms, courts, a sauna, a cafe, and a retail store under one roof.
entries.why: The most ambitious creator-built gym in the world, a self-described 'Disney World for bodybuilders' that pulls visitors from across Texas and beyond.
entries.takeaway: Treat it like a day trip — three gyms, courts, a sauna and a cafe built by a YouTuber into one compound.

entries.name: Third Space Canary Wharf
entries.who: Three-floor, 100,000-square-foot luxury health club with a pool, climbing wall and in-house medical centre.
entries.why: Widely cited as the largest luxury gym in Europe; sets the bar for the UK's premium health-club format.
entries.takeaway: See the pool, climbing wall and in-house medical centre that make this the largest luxury gym in Europe.

entries.name: Original Muscle Beach
entries.who: Restored 1930s beach gymnastics ground next to the pier, considered the birthplace of the US fitness boom.
entries.why: Site of the WPA-built rings and bars that started outdoor physical culture in America; dismantled in 1959, rebuilt and reopened by the city in 1989.
entries.reach: No official gym IG; run by the City of Santa Monica (approx 2026)
entries.takeaway: Try the rings and bars on the WPA-built ground considered the birthplace of America's outdoor fitness culture.

entries.name: Academia Publica do Arpoador
entries.who: Free oceanfront outdoor gym between Ipanema and Copacabana with squat racks, benches, and free weights, not just bodyweight bars.
entries.why: A daily pilgrimage spot for locals and tourists who want to lift with an Atlantic Ocean backdrop; confirmed active as of 2026 travel guides.
entries.reach: No official IG; free municipal facility (verified open 2026-08)
entries.takeaway: Lift with real squat racks and free weights, not just bars, against an Atlantic Ocean backdrop, for free.

entries.name: Boss Barbell Club
entries.who: Powerlifting-focused gym in Silicon Valley owned and coached day-to-day by 10x world-record raw powerlifter Dan Green.
entries.why: One of the few US gyms run hands-on by an active elite competitor; the anchor of the Northern California powerlifting scene.
entries.takeaway: Rare chance to train under an active 10x world-record powerlifter who coaches the floor himself.

entries.name: Sorinex Strength Compound
entries.who: Manufacturing headquarters and private training facility of Sorinex, the strength-equipment maker used by NFL, NBA and major college athletic departments.
entries.why: World-unique showroom/training floor that visiting college strength coaches and pro athletes treat as a pilgrimage stop for equipment and technique.
entries.takeaway: Go for the equipment as much as the training — visiting strength coaches treat this showroom as a pilgrimage stop.

entries.name: Tempelhofer Feld Calisthenics Park
entries.who: Free outdoor calisthenics setup on the former Tempelhof Airport airfield, one of the largest open-air training grounds in Europe.
entries.why: A gathering point for Europe's competitive calisthenics scene, prized for its scale and for training in the open field of a decommissioned airport.
entries.reach: No official IG; public park facility (approx 2026)
entries.takeaway: Free and vast — join Europe's competitive calisthenics scene training out in the open field of a decommissioned airport.

entries.name: Oxygen Gym
entries.who: Leading hardcore bodybuilding gym brand in Kuwait, a hub for the country's outsized competitive bodybuilding scene.
entries.why: The best-known gym name in Gulf bodybuilding culture, with a huge regional social following and heavy competition-prep traffic.
entries.takeaway: Expect heavy competition-prep traffic — this is the anchor gym of Kuwait's outsized competitive bodybuilding scene.

entries.name: Siro One Za'abeel
entries.who: 132-room fitness-and-recovery hotel inside the One Za'abeel tower, built around dedicated Fitness and Recovery Labs.
entries.why: The world's first hotel purpose-built for training and recovery, not a gym bolted onto a hotel; a genuine trip destination for serious trainers.
entries.takeaway: Book the Fitness and Recovery Labs, not just a room — this hotel was purpose-built for training and recovery.

entries.name: Tracy Anderson Studio New York
entries.who: Flagship studio of Tracy Anderson's branded dance-cardio method, which now runs ten studios worldwide.
entries.why: Built the celebrity-trainer-to-global-method playbook; the studio her A-list clientele and the tabloids still associate with the brand.
entries.takeaway: Take the dance-cardio class that built the celebrity-trainer-to-global-method playbook still followed by an A-list clientele.

entries.name: B-Team Jiu-Jitsu
entries.who: Austin no-gi grappling team founded in 2021 by former members of the Danaher Death Squad.
entries.why: Built a large online following around elite no-gi grappling and continues to produce top ADCC competitors.
entries.warning: Founding roster has shifted since 2021 as some members split off to form separate teams.
entries.takeaway: Watch the elite no-gi grappling system built by former Danaher Death Squad members, still producing ADCC competitors.

entries.name: KX Chelsea
entries.who: Private members' health, fitness and beauty club on Draycott Avenue, open since 2002 with a spa, pool and training floor.
entries.why: One of London's original luxury gym-clubs, still a fixture for the Chelsea and Kensington set more than two decades on.
entries.takeaway: A private club fixture for the Chelsea set for two decades — go for the spa-and-training-floor combination, not lifting volume.

entries.name: Anatomy Miami Beach
entries.who: Boutique strength and wellness club on Lincoln Road, co-founded by former NFL player Marc Megna, with sister locations across greater Miami.
entries.why: Anchors Miami's fitness-and-wellness scene, drawing athletes, models and the city's wellness-influencer circuit.
entries.takeaway: Expect a wellness-influencer crowd — this club anchors Miami's fitness scene for athletes and models alike.

entries.name: Kill Cliff FC
entries.who: South Florida MMA team, formerly the Blackzilians, Hard Knocks 365, and Sanford MMA.
entries.why: Home to UFC standouts Michael Chandler, Gilbert Burns, and Robbie Lawler after several rebrands.
entries.warning: Renamed several times (Blackzilians, Hard Knocks 365, Sanford MMA, then Kill Cliff FC in 2022).
entries.takeaway: Train where Michael Chandler, Gilbert Burns and Robbie Lawler built their games, under whatever name it currently carries.

entries.name: Alliance Jiu-Jitsu San Diego
entries.who: San Diego branch of Alliance Jiu-Jitsu, one of the most decorated BJJ organizations in the world.
entries.why: Alliance has won more IBJJF World titles than any other team, and the San Diego room trains competitive black belts.
entries.takeaway: Roll with competitive black belts from the team that has won more IBJJF World titles than any other.

entries.name: Strength Asylum
entries.who: 13,500 sq ft bodybuilding/strongman gym in Stoke-on-Trent, training base of former World's Strongest Man Eddie Hall.
entries.why: One of the best-known strongman gyms in the UK; Eddie Hall's decade-long membership put it on the map internationally.
entries.takeaway: Check out the strongman setup Eddie Hall trained in for a decade — his membership put this gym on the map.

entries.name: Doherty's Gym
entries.who: Australia's best-known hardcore bodybuilding gym group, anchored by its 24/7 Melbourne City location.
entries.why: The default training base for Australia's competitive bodybuilding and powerlifting scene for decades, open every day of the year.
entries.takeaway: Open every day of the year — this has been the default base for Australia's competitive lifting scene for decades.

entries.name: Ironberg (São Paulo)
entries.who: A 24-hour flagship of Brazil's Ironberg chain, self-described as Latin America's largest bodybuilding training center.
entries.why: Anchors Brazil's large, IFBB-heavy bodybuilding scene inside one of the region's biggest and busiest training floors.
entries.takeaway: Expect one of the region's biggest, busiest training floors anchoring Brazil's IFBB-heavy bodybuilding scene.

entries.name: Untamed Strength
entries.who: Alan Thrall's strongman/powerlifting gym in Sacramento, built around raw barbell training and heavy YouTube documentation.
entries.why: Thrall's instructional videos turned an ordinary local gym into one of the most-watched strength channels in the world.
entries.takeaway: Watch the raw barbell fundamentals Alan Thrall built into one of the most-watched strength channels in the world.

entries.name: Barbell Brigade
entries.who: 5,500 sq ft powerlifting and strength-sports gym in downtown LA with 16 squat racks, 11 benches, and its own apparel/media brand.
entries.why: Hosts USAPL and USPA meets on-site and built one of the largest powerlifting-apparel followings out of a single physical gym.
entries.takeaway: Catch a USAPL or USPA meet on-site, then train on the same racks that host them.

entries.name: California Strength
entries.who: Olympic weightlifting gym and coaching program, one of the longest-running dedicated weightlifting clubs in the US.
entries.why: Coached multiple national-level weightlifters over nearly two decades and remains a reference program for USAW-style training.
entries.takeaway: Learn USAW-style Olympic lifting from one of the longest-running dedicated weightlifting clubs in the country.

entries.name: Gold's Gym Golden Heights
entries.who: One of Gold's Gym Egypt's flagship compound clubs, part of the brand's largest Middle East-North Africa footprint.
entries.why: The clearest Gold's Gym presence in the Arab world's biggest fitness market, drawing on the same brand equity as Venice's original.
entries.warning: Reach figure is for the national Gold's Gym Egypt brand account, not this location specifically.
entries.takeaway: Trades on the same Gold's Gym name as Venice — go see how that legacy plays in the Arab world's biggest fitness market.

entries.name: SoulCycle Tribeca
entries.who: Long-running flagship studio of the candlelit indoor-cycling chain that popularized boutique group fitness in the US.
entries.why: Along with SoulCycle's original Union Square studio, defined the 2010s boutique-fitness boom that Barry's, Rumble and 1Rebel all followed.
entries.reach: IG unverified for this studio; brand has scaled back to roughly 57 US locations (2026)
entries.warning: SoulCycle has closed many studios nationwide since 2023; check this location is operating before visiting.
entries.takeaway: Book the candlelit ride that helped define the 2010s boutique-fitness boom — confirm the studio is still open first.

entries.name: THENX Fitness Studio
entries.who: Calisthenics training studio in Miami built around Chris Heria's THENX brand, the home base seen throughout his videos.
entries.why: Anchors one of the largest calisthenics content ecosystems online; THENX and Heria Pro programs trace back to this floor.
entries.reach: IG 2M (Chris Heria's personal following, verified 2026-08; the studio itself has no separate large account)
entries.takeaway: See the calisthenics setup behind Chris Heria's videos, home base of one of the biggest content ecosystems online.

entries.name: Royal Docks CrossFit
entries.who: East London box next to the ExCeL centre, one of the UK's most competition-focused CrossFit gyms.
entries.why: A regular stop for touring elite athletes training in London, including Mat Fraser, Tia-Clair Toomey and Rich Froning.
entries.takeaway: A regular stop for touring elite athletes — you might share a WOD with a Games champion passing through London.

entries.name: Smart Fit Copacabana
entries.who: Headquarters location of Smart Fit, Latin America's largest gym chain (2,100-plus locations), with an attached beach-sports arena for futevolei and beach tennis.
entries.why: Represents the low-cost mega-gym model that reshaped fitness access across Latin America; the beach arena add-on is a rare format extension.
entries.reach: No location-specific IG data; brand-level presence is large (approx 2026)
entries.takeaway: Try the attached beach-sports arena for futevolei and beach tennis, a rare add-on at the chain's flagship.

entries.name: Armbrust Pro Gym
entries.who: Josh Bryant's strength-and-physique hybrid gym, known for a dedicated leg room with eight-plus Olympic power racks.
entries.why: Trains IFBB pros and elite strength athletes and serves as a serious destination for hardcore leg and powerlifting-style training.
entries.takeaway: Hit the dedicated leg room with its stacked power racks — where IFBB pros go for serious leg work.

entries.name: Choopan Classic Gym
entries.who: A 130-plus-machine gym Mr. Olympia champion Hadi Choopan built in his home region of Iran.
entries.why: A symbol of Iran's rising bodybuilding pipeline and Choopan's effort to give back to the community that produced a world champion despite travel barriers to Western training hubs.
entries.reach: Covered widely in bodybuilding press through 2025-2026; gym's own social reach not independently verified this pass
entries.takeaway: See what a Mr. Olympia champion built for his own community when travel to Western training hubs wasn't an option.

entries.name: Heimat
entries.who: 75,000-square-foot members-only fitness and lifestyle club in Hollywood with a rooftop pool, spa and six specialty studios.
entries.why: Billed as the first standalone luxury gym concept in LA; blends training with a social club and carries a long waitlist.
entries.takeaway: Get on the waitlist for a club that blends training with social life — LA's first standalone luxury gym concept.

entries.name: Saint Haven Collingwood
entries.who: Members-only luxury wellness and social club combining strength training, recovery labs and a lounge-and-dining floor.
entries.why: Built a reported 15,000-person waitlist; the clearest sign Australia's premium fitness scene has gone full country-club, now expanding to Sydney.
entries.takeaway: A 15,000-person waitlist tells you fitness has gone full country-club — go for the recovery labs and lounge, not just the weights.

entries.name: Xtreme Couture MMA
entries.who: Las Vegas MMA gym founded by UFC Hall of Famer Randy Couture, now run by his son Ryan Couture.
entries.why: Historic UFC pedigree from the Couture era continues under family ownership, with an open floor for visitors.
entries.takeaway: Train on an open floor that still carries Randy Couture's UFC Hall of Fame pedigree under his son's ownership.

entries.name: Shaw Strength and Conditioning
entries.who: Training facility and brand built by four-time World's Strongest Man Brian Shaw for strongman-style training.
entries.why: One of the few facilities purpose-built around a reigning WSM champion's own equipment and programming.
entries.reach: follower count not verified this session (approx 2026)
entries.takeaway: Rare setup built entirely around a four-time World's Strongest Man's own equipment and programming.

entries.name: Quads Gym
entries.who: A 40,000 sq ft hardcore bodybuilding gym on Chicago's North Side, running since 1976 and nicknamed "Land of the Giants."
entries.why: A Midwest bodybuilding institution with decades of old-school iron culture; voted a top-10 gym in America.
entries.takeaway: Old-school iron culture since 1976 — earn your spot in what regulars call the Land of the Giants.

entries.name: World Gym (Venice)
entries.who: Joe Gold's second Venice gym, founded in 1976 after he sold the original Gold's Gym, since relocated within Venice.
entries.why: The historic rival mecca to Gold's Gym Venice, once home to Arnold Schwarzenegger, Lou Ferrigno, and the golden-era crew, and the root of the worldwide World Gym chain.
entries.reach: Relocated within Venice; current location's follower count not independently verified this pass
entries.takeaway: Visit the historic rival to Gold's Gym Venice — once home to Arnold and Ferrigno, and the root of a worldwide chain.

entries.name: Lanserhof at The Arts Club
entries.who: Six-floor medical gym and wellness clinic inside The Arts Club, with an in-house MRI, cryotherapy and a Spine Lab.
entries.why: Billed as the world's first medical gym; brings Lanserhof's German longevity-clinic model into a private London institution.
entries.takeaway: Expect medical diagnostics alongside training — an in-house MRI, cryotherapy and Spine Lab make this the world's first medical gym.

entries.name: Mike's Gym
entries.who: Dutch kickboxing gym near Amsterdam led by trainer Michael "Big Mike" Passenier.
entries.why: Produced Glory kickboxing champions such as Murthel Groenhart and Joerie Mes, a hub of Dutch kickboxing.
entries.takeaway: Train in the hub of Dutch kickboxing that produced Glory champions Murthel Groenhart and Joerie Mes.

entries.name: Iron Religion Gym
entries.who: 24/7 hardcore bodybuilding and powerlifting gym on International Drive, open since 2016.
entries.why: A regular stop for pros passing through Orlando for the Olympia Expo, built on old-school equipment mixed with modern plate-loaded gear.
entries.takeaway: Catch touring pros stopping through during Olympia Expo week on this mix of old-school and modern equipment.

entries.name: Raw Athletic Club
entries.who: Premium gym opened in 2024 by five-time Classic Physique Olympia champion Chris Bumstead's Raw Nutrition brand, with a barber, smoothie bar, and apparel shop attached.
entries.why: The newest major creator-gym launch in bodybuilding, already drawing touring pros to train and film on camera.
entries.takeaway: Newest creator-gym on the circuit — watch touring pros train and film on camera at Bumstead's Raw Nutrition floor.

entries.name: John Reed Fitness Club Berlin-Botzow
entries.who: RSG Group's flagship John Reed club in central Berlin, built around the brand's nightclub-style design language.
entries.why: Set the template for the DJ-decks-and-art-deco gym aesthetic that John Reed exported across Europe.
entries.takeaway: Go for the DJ-decks-and-art-deco design language John Reed exported across Europe, not a quiet lift.

entries.name: Ultimate Performance London City
entries.who: Private, no-membership personal-training gym; the original Ultimate Performance location, opened 2009, now heading a nine-gym London roster.
entries.why: Set the template for premium one-to-one fat-loss and physique coaching that UP now runs in 20-plus cities worldwide.
entries.takeaway: No membership, just one-to-one coaching — this original location set the template UP now runs in 20-plus cities.

entries.name: Mayweather Boxing Club
entries.who: Floyd Mayweather's private boxing gym and training center in Las Vegas.
entries.why: Where the undefeated five-division champion trained and still mentors fighters; a stop for boxing tourists in Vegas.
entries.takeaway: Stop in where an undefeated five-division champion still mentors fighters — a must for boxing tourists in Vegas.

entries.name: McFit Flagship Berlin
entries.who: RSG Group's flagship McFit club, rebuilt as what the company calls "the world's greenest gym."
entries.why: McFit, founded 1997, grew into Europe's largest fitness chain by membership; this club is the brand's current showcase.
entries.takeaway: See the brand's current showcase, rebuilt to be what the company calls the world's greenest gym.

entries.name: Virgin Active Collection Green Point
entries.who: Virgin Active's rebuilt flagship club, a roughly $6.2 million, 5,500-square-meter "social wellness club" combining training, recovery, nutrition, and co-working space.
entries.why: Africa's most ambitious gym rebuild to date, positioned by Richard Branson as the future format for the continent's largest health-club operator.
entries.reach: No IG follower count confirmed for this location (approx 2026)
entries.takeaway: Explore the social-wellness-club format — training, recovery, nutrition and co-working under one roof, Africa's most ambitious gym rebuild.

entries.name: Iron Addicts Gym
entries.who: The gym CT Fletcher built his brand around; still running under new ownership after Fletcher's exit from day-to-day operations.
entries.why: Years of viral "It's a lifestyle!" training footage made this a global reference point for hardcore strength culture, and the location keeps that identity.
entries.reach: Active social presence; follower count not confirmed this pass (verified open 2026-08)
entries.warning: CT Fletcher is no longer associated with day-to-day operation of this location; the gym continues under different ownership.
entries.takeaway: Come for the hardcore strength-culture identity CT Fletcher's viral footage built, even though he no longer runs the floor.

entries.name: 1st Phorm HQ
entries.who: 185,000 sq ft supplement-company headquarters with a full athletic facility, turf field, and basketball court, built by 1st Phorm founder Andy Frisella's team.
entries.why: One of the most-toured facilities on fitness YouTube — a supplement brand's HQ built as a destination gym, not just an office.
entries.reach: IG 1M (1st Phorm brand account; approx 2026, not gym-specific)
entries.takeaway: Take the tour — this supplement company built its HQ as a destination gym, not just an office.

entries.name: Gordon Beach Outdoor Gym
entries.who: Free municipal outdoor gym on the Tel Aviv beach promenade with bars, rings, and calisthenics stations.
entries.why: A long-running fixture of Tel Aviv beach culture where regulars train daily regardless of weather or season.
entries.reach: No official IG; municipal beachfront facility (approx 2026)
entries.takeaway: Free beachfront bars and rings — join the regulars who train here daily no matter the season.

entries.name: MetroFlex Gym Long Beach
entries.who: MetroFlex's Southern California outpost, a hardcore bodybuilding and powerlifting gym near Long Beach.
entries.why: Carries the MetroFlex chain's coaching culture and equipment standard into the dense SoCal bodybuilding scene.
entries.reach: Instagram @metroflexlbc; open, follower count not confirmed (verified 2026-08)
entries.takeaway: Expect the same MetroFlex coaching culture and equipment standard as the original, dropped into the dense SoCal bodybuilding scene.

entries.name: FIBRA MAX
entries.who: "The Athletes' Factory," billed as the largest weight-training gym in Europe, opened in 2024 with 400-plus machines and dumbbells.
entries.why: A new-generation European mega-gym putting Spain on the map for large-scale strength and physique training.
entries.reach: Described in press as Europe's largest weight-training gym; follower count not independently verified this pass
entries.takeaway: See the scale for yourself — 400-plus machines make this the largest weight-training gym in Europe.

entries.name: Roufusport MMA Academy
entries.who: Milwaukee-area MMA academy led by striking coach Duke Roufus.
entries.why: Produced UFC and Bellator champions Anthony Pettis and Ben Askren under Roufus's striking system.
entries.takeaway: Study the striking system under Duke Roufus that produced UFC and Bellator champions Anthony Pettis and Ben Askren.

entries.name: XT Oslo
entries.who: One of the largest and oldest CrossFit facilities in Europe, spread across three training halls.
entries.why: Anchors Oslo's functional-fitness scene, which also hosts the Oslo Throwdown, one of Northern Europe's biggest CrossFit competitions.
entries.takeaway: Three training halls anchor a scene that also runs the Oslo Throwdown, one of Northern Europe's biggest CrossFit events.

entries.name: Hybrid Performance Method Gym
entries.who: 24-hour private strength facility in Wynwood built for powerlifting, Olympic weightlifting, strongman and combat conditioning, home to Team HYBRID.
entries.why: Founder Hayden Bowe's training app and podcast audience funnels a large online following toward one physical floor.
entries.takeaway: Expect a mix of powerlifting, Olympic lifting, strongman and combat conditioning under Hayden Bowe's Team HYBRID banner.

entries.name: Obsidian Gym Bali
entries.who: The largest gym in Indonesia: a 6,000 sqm design-forward complex in Pererenan/Canggu with a pool, cold plunge, sauna, and the country's longest dumbbell row, opened 2023.
entries.why: Went viral worldwide for its striking architecture and design, turning it into a bucket-list stop for Bali's digital-nomad fitness crowd.
entries.takeaway: Go for the striking architecture and the country's longest dumbbell row — this went viral for design, not just iron.

entries.name: Continuum Club West Village
entries.who: 25,000-square-foot, $10,000-a-month members' wellness club in the West Village, capped at 250 members with AI-assisted biometric onboarding.
entries.why: The newest and most expensive entrant in ultra-luxury fitness, setting a new price ceiling for what a gym membership can cost.
entries.takeaway: Expect AI-assisted biometric onboarding and a $10,000-a-month price tag — the new ceiling for ultra-luxury fitness.

entries.name: Virgin Active Collection Kensington
entries.who: Flagship 'Collection' club on Kensington High Street with a 16-metre pool, spa and one of London's largest Dynamic Reformer studios.
entries.why: Leads the redevelopment of Virgin Active's whole UK portfolio into a hospitality-led, studio-rich format.
entries.takeaway: See the pool and reformer studio leading Virgin Active's shift toward a hospitality-led, studio-rich club format.

entries.name: Cape CrossFit
entries.who: South Africa's most competitive CrossFit team gym, a fixture of the Cape Town functional-fitness scene.
entries.why: The winningest team in Fittest in Cape Town history and a Regionals qualifier every year since 2011.
entries.takeaway: Train with the winningest team in Fittest in Cape Town history, a Regionals qualifier every year since 2011.

entries.name: Fitness Time Pro Gym Riyadh
entries.who: Flagship performance club of Fitness Time, Saudi Arabia's largest homegrown gym chain.
entries.why: Anchors a fitness brand family that expanded fast across the Kingdom's gender-segmented gym market.
entries.reach: No single confirmed IG for this location; sister brand @ftladies has 201K (approx 2026)
entries.takeaway: Anchor location for Saudi Arabia's largest homegrown gym chain, built for the Kingdom's gender-segmented gym market.

entries.name: Ultra Gym at The Charlee Hotel
entries.who: Glass-walled wellness gym atop The Charlee Lifestyle Hotel in El Poblado, Medellin, with panoramic city views, a group-class studio, and a sauna/jacuzzi wet zone; day passes (about 60,000 COP) are sold to non-guests, so access is not hotel-guests-only.
entries.why: Floor-to-ceiling city views and the hotel's celebrity-sighting reputation make it a photographed, sought-after stop in Poblado's boutique-hotel fitness scene.
entries.reach: IG 34K (hotel account @hotelthecharlee, verified 2026-08; Ultra Gym has no separate account)
entries.takeaway: Buy a day pass (about 60,000 COP) for the panoramic glass-walled views — you don't need to be a hotel guest.

entries.name: Juggernaut Training Systems HQ
entries.who: Powerlifting gym and coaching HQ built by Chad Wesley Smith's Juggernaut Training Systems, pairing sports-science content with a hardcore lifting floor.
entries.why: A hub for competitive powerlifters and one of the most-followed programming brands in strength sport.
entries.takeaway: Pair sports-science thinking with hardcore lifting on the floor behind one of strength sport's most-followed programming brands.

entries.name: CrossFit Kailua
entries.who: Community box on Oahu built around the Hawaiian concept of ohana (family), with a roster of CrossFit Games-level members.
entries.why: One of the sport's early Games-era affiliates, still drawing fitness travelers to Hawaii's CrossFit scene.
entries.takeaway: Train inside the ohana concept — a community box with Games-level members still drawing fitness travelers to Hawaii.

bubblingUnder.name: Underground Strength Gym
bubblingUnder.who: Zach Even-Esh's strength gym for athletes, built on old-school barbell, sandbag and kettlebell training rather than machines.
bubblingUnder.why: Its coaching methodology and long-running content library shaped a generation of high-school and college strength coaches.
bubblingUnder.reach: follower count not verified this session (approx 2026)
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Skip the machines — train the old-school barbell, sandbag and kettlebell system that shaped a generation of strength coaches.

bubblingUnder.name: GymNation Sheikh Zayed Road
bubblingUnder.who: Flagship club of GymNation, now the largest gym operator in the UAE with 45,000-plus members across 40-plus clubs.
bubblingUnder.why: Grew to 10,000 members within a year of opening and became the model location for the brand's low-cost mega-gym push across the Gulf.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: See the low-cost mega-gym model that hit 10,000 members within a year and now leads GymNation's Gulf expansion.

bubblingUnder.name: Sport City Flagship
bubblingUnder.who: Flagship campus of Sport City, Mexico's long-running premium fitness and country-club chain with pools, courts, and full gym floors.
bubblingUnder.why: A decades-old fixture of upper-middle-class Mexican fitness culture, distinct from the budget mega-gym model spreading elsewhere in Latin America.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Expect a country-club feel — pools and courts alongside weights, a fixture distinct from Latin America's budget mega-gyms.

bubblingUnder.name: MetroFlex Gym Japan
bubblingUnder.who: MetroFlex's first Asia location, in Saitama Prefecture, importing the chain's rare equipment and hardcore culture.
bubblingUnder.why: A pilgrimage stop for Japanese and touring lifters seeking MetroFlex's specific old-school machines and floor culture outside the US.
bubblingUnder.reach: Instagram @metroflex_gym_japan; open, active as of mid-2026 (verified 2026-08)
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Seek the same rare MetroFlex equipment and hardcore culture as the Texas original, now on the ground in Japan.

bubblingUnder.name: S10 Training
bubblingUnder.who: Boutique strength studio with an onsite recovery spa and cafe, founded by trainer Stephen Cheuk.
bubblingUnder.why: A go-to for entertainment-industry clients chasing single-digit body fat; small in scale but disproportionately visible via press and social.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Small but disproportionately visible — this is where entertainment-industry clients go chasing single-digit body fat.

bubblingUnder.name: 1Rebel Broadgate
bubblingUnder.who: Flagship reshape/ride/rumble studio of the UK boutique-fitness chain, inside the Broadgate financial-district complex.
bubblingUnder.why: Pioneered London's boutique-fitness-as-nightclub format, with DJ booths, sound systems and light shows built into the workout.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Expect a nightclub, not a gym floor — DJ booths and light shows are built into every workout here.

bubblingUnder.name: Rumble Boxing New York
bubblingUnder.who: Original boxing-and-strength studio from the chain founded by celebrity trainer Noah Neiman.
bubblingUnder.why: Helped bring boutique boxing into the mainstream studio-fitness category alongside Barry's and SoulCycle.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Take the original boxing-and-strength class that helped bring boutique boxing mainstream alongside Barry's and SoulCycle.

bubblingUnder.name: Overtime Athletics
bubblingUnder.who: Powerbuilding gym associated with boxer and content creator Mike Rashid, known for raw, no-frills strength content.
bubblingUnder.why: One of the earlier gyms to build an identity purely from documentary-style YouTube training footage.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Expect the same raw, no-frills content style Mike Rashid built his following on — training filmed like a documentary.

bubblingUnder.name: CrossFit Condesa
bubblingUnder.who: 800-square-meter box in central Mexico City, formerly branded Reebok CrossFit Plaza Condesa.
bubblingUnder.why: One of the largest and longest-running CrossFit facilities in Latin America's second-biggest CrossFit market.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Train in one of the largest, longest-running CrossFit facilities in Latin America's second-biggest CrossFit market.

bubblingUnder.name: Wasatch CrossFit
bubblingUnder.who: Davis County box coaching Salt Lake City-area athletes since 2007, one of Utah's first CrossFit affiliates.
bubblingUnder.why: 2017 CrossFit Games Affiliate Cup champions, a genuine national title that put a small-market gym on the map.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Ask about the 2017 CrossFit Games Affiliate Cup banner — a genuine national title from one of Utah's first affiliates.

bubblingUnder.name: Gymbox Covent Garden
bubblingUnder.who: Original flagship of the UK's theatrical HIIT and boxing chain, known for stunt-style class production.
bubblingUnder.why: Redefined UK boutique group fitness with dramatic class concepts (fire, black-light boxing) well before the format went mainstream.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Book a stunt-style class — fire, black-light boxing — the theatrical format that redefined UK group fitness early.

bubblingUnder.name: F45 Training Bondi Beach
bubblingUnder.who: One of the earliest F45 studios, in the beachside neighborhood where the global team-training franchise was founded.
bubblingUnder.why: Ground zero for a chain that scaled to thousands of studios worldwide and went public on Nasdaq off the strength of this format.
bubblingUnder.reach: IG unverified for this specific studio; global F45 brand account is far larger (2026)
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Visit the beachside studio where the F45 team-training format began before scaling to a Nasdaq listing.

bubblingUnder.name: American Iron Gym
bubblingUnder.who: Powerlifting and Olympic weightlifting gym owned by Bob and Tammy Lopes, running for over three decades.
bubblingUnder.why: One of Nevada's oldest dedicated barbell-sport gyms, a regional institution for USAPL and USAW lifters.
bubblingUnder.reach: presence confirmed, follower count not verified this session (2026-08)
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Train barbell sport at a three-decade Nevada institution built for serious USAPL and USAW lifters.

bubblingUnder.name: Allegiate Gym
bubblingUnder.city: Los Angeles, California (Century City / Santa Monica)
bubblingUnder.who: High-end strength & conditioning studio group founded by former Army West Point strength coach Tim Caron, floors equipped with Eleiko, Sorinex, and Kabuki gear.
bubblingUnder.why: Brings Division-1-level programming and force-plate testing tech (GymAware, ForceDecks, NordBord) into a boutique-membership model.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Expect Division-1-level programming and force-plate testing tech — GymAware, ForceDecks, NordBord — inside a boutique membership.

bubblingUnder.name: Fitness First Market Street
bubblingUnder.who: Fitness First's two-floor, 21,000-square-foot flagship club in the Singapore CBD.
bubblingUnder.why: The brand's showcase for its current club design in Southeast Asia's premium fitness market.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: See the brand's current club-design showcase for Southeast Asia's premium fitness market.

bubblingUnder.name: SKILL CGN
bubblingUnder.who: Official Hyrox performance-training gym in Cologne, one of Germany's hubs for the fast-growing race format.
bubblingUnder.why: Sits inside Hyrox's home market of Germany, which hosts some of the sport's largest annual events.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Train Hyrox-specific programming in the sport's home market, which hosts some of its largest annual events.

bubblingUnder.name: Lvl Up CrossFit
bubblingUnder.who: CrossFit affiliate in Dubai's IMPZ district, part of the emirate's fast-growing functional-fitness box scene.
bubblingUnder.why: Represents Dubai's cluster of expat-driven CrossFit boxes that has grown alongside the city's fitness-tourism boom.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Join Dubai's growing cluster of expat-driven CrossFit boxes, part of the city's fitness-tourism boom.

bubblingUnder.name: Second City CrossFit
bubblingUnder.who: One of Chicago's longest-running CrossFit boxes, a community fixture of the city's functional-fitness scene.
bubblingUnder.why: Represents the deep bench of veteran, non-flagship urban boxes that anchor CrossFit's everyday culture in major US cities.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Experience CrossFit's everyday culture at one of Chicago's longest-running, non-flagship community boxes.

bubblingUnder.name: Kris Gethin Gyms Gurugram
bubblingUnder.who: Luxury training club under the Kris Gethin Gyms brand, built by the celebrity bodybuilding coach and Jag Chima to bring premium transformation coaching to India.
bubblingUnder.why: Represents the celebrity-led push to build Western-style luxury bodybuilding gyms in India's fast-growing fitness market.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: See the celebrity-led push for Western-style luxury bodybuilding coaching in India's fast-growing fitness market.

bubblingUnder.name: Team Training UK
bubblingUnder.who: Official Hyrox training club in Cheshire, offering dedicated Hyrox race-prep programming alongside general fitness classes.
bubblingUnder.why: One of the UK's earliest gyms built specifically around Hyrox racing rather than retrofitted from a CrossFit box.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: Train Hyrox-specific race prep at one of the UK's first gyms built for the format from scratch, not retrofitted.

bubblingUnder.name: Atlas Training Club
bubblingUnder.who: South Manchester and Cheshire's first gym built specifically for Hyrox training.
bubblingUnder.why: Illustrates Hyrox's rapid spread into purpose-built training clubs across the UK beyond London.
bubblingUnder.takeaway: See Hyrox's rapid spread beyond London at South Manchester and Cheshire's first gym purpose-built for the format.
